Frettin-Second doesn't seem to know what to do with this idea. "Well, no, but…yes, uh… S-sorry, I need to go think about things!" With that, they take off at a loping run. As they leave, they call back, "Thank you for the stone!"

Joy's History shrugs and adds, "What a nervous Fress."

choices: Try to scare the thing away
Try to quietly cross the water
description:
Nomiani and Joy's History decide to head on towards the swamps. Solid ground gives way to mud and then opaque water all around them. A large creature moves steadily through the swamp in the middle distance…it's a creature that hasn't been seen before: a silhouette with a long neck and long hair.

Joy's History doesn't seem to know what it is, and they shrink back, saying "Woah! Um…no idea if THAT thing is safe!"

choices: Stop to look a little closer
description: Nomiani and Joy's History elect to quietly swim across the swamp. The creature turns its head to watch them, but otherwise doesn't move towards them or appear threatening. They reach the opposite bank, and Joy's History says, "Whew! Guess it's busy…"

choices: Try and think about what's familiar here
Keep heading to the plasticine pit
description:
Nomiani stops to look a little closer. "Hey, shouldn't we keep going?..." says Joy's History.

But, the creature just dips its head into the swamp water and comes back up with a mouthful of water reeds, which it chews on quietly. It appears horse-like, with an exceptionally long neck layered with stringy hair. Its coloring appears blotchy brown and greenish. Whatever it is, it appears herbivorous. Joy's History notes this, saying, "Oh, looks like it just eats plants, huh?"

choices: I think I need to keep going.
description:
Nomiani stops to think about if there's something familiar here. However, they only see the strange keyboard once again, adding more to the message from before: "DO TO AVOID THE" is added before they again lose the thought and it goes black.

They return to where they just were on the swamp shore, with Joy's History hovering over them. "Woah, you okay? You kind of drifted off there…"

Nomiani responds, "I think I need to keep going."
Joy's History gives an enthusiastic "Okay, let's go!" and they move on to the next area.

Here, the swamp is beginning to thin out a bit, and winding paths lead to rockier areas ahead. A couple of stray bones lay by the side of the shallow shores. A moss-covered overhang protects what looks like a large nest, filled with round, gray, peeping bird-like creatures. A stray one stays on top of the overhang, looking a bit lost.

Joy's History remarks, "Looks like we're getting closer to that pit…"

choices: Return the stray chup to the nest
description:
Nomiani elects to pick up the bird creature. They have no issue picking it up. It's added to their inventory as a 'stray chup.'

Joy's History asks, "What're you gonna do with that?"

choices: No? It needed to go home!
tags: is worth many in the nest
description:
Nomiani decides to put the stray chup back in the nest. It joins all of the other chups in the big huddle, and is removed from their inventory.

Joy's History remarks, "Oh…I thought you were getting a snack!"

choices: I'd rather help than hurt things.
Should I take one just in case?
description:
Nomiani replies, "No? It needed to go home!"

Joy's History says, "Haha, aww, it's weird what things you care about…but kind of cute, too!" They motion to the nest full of chirping chups. "Chups are easy snacks for most things that eat meat."

Nomiani says, "I'd rather help than hurt things."

Joy's History replies, "It's weird, but also…yeah, that seems really true about you! It's sincere…I don't get it, but I like it!" They seem satisfied with this explanation.

choices: Go and grab a chup for the road
description:
Nomiani picks up the scattered bones. They got the sawaim bones!

Joy's History comments, "Uhh…no clue what those belong to. Creatures having bones is so weird. Long rocks all stuck inside your body…ick!"

choices: Okay. Thank you for coming this far.
I've changed my mind. I'm going back, too.
description:
Nomiani elects to keep heading towards the pit. They crest over the hill, and look out towards dry, hilly terrain. A snaking, layered pit lays before them. The pit steeps down in tiers, each with what appear to be layers of sparkling stone. It's much drier than the swamps they left.

Joy's History turns to Nomiani. "Hey…this is as far as I can go. This looks a bit too dry and dangerous. But…I hope you find what you're looking for! If you do, come back to the shore and tell me what you find, okay?"

Nomiani says, "Okay. Thank you for coming this far."
With that, the two part ways. Joy's History heads back towards the swamps, and Nomiani continues down towards the layered pit. Once down there, they stop and look around. It's eerily quiet. The pit is lined with layers of soft, pressed stones that seem to sparkle. Some of the sparkle has flaked off into piles of powder.

Nomiani elects to examine the strata first. Looking closely, there's a layer of stone that's mostly bits of plasticite and other translucent, sparkling bits compressed together. But there's also things that are strangely familiar…a wire? Colored glass? A flat, metal wafer with tiny lines etched into it?
Nomiani elects to pick up the sparkling powder. But without something to hold it in, it’s going to keep spilling everywhere!
Nomiani decides to go south. It's starting to get a little darker. There are some old metal slats in the ground, and other strange creatures scurry just out of sight.
Nomiani picked up the metal slats. But now their inventory is full, and there's no room to carry anything else.

choices: Put the sparkling powder in the metal container
description: Nomiani decides to go northwest, higher up. Some bits of metal and other odd ends are scattered around. There's a gentler slope back in the direction they came from, and a steeper one that seems to lead to the very bottom of the ravine.

choices: Take the gentle slope to the south
Take the steep slope to the west
description: Nomiani picks up the metal container and places the remaining sparkling powder inside. Now at least the sparkling powder will stop spilling everywhere.

choices: Toss out the crop shrimp to them
Go back and try the other slope
description: Nomiani elects to take the gentle slope southward. As they head down, they see the path is blocked by a lot of rodent-like creatures scurrying around. There appears to be a shiny object ahead, and the path through the rodents leads to the same area the steep slope did.

choices: Stop to pick up the shiny object
description: Nomiani tosses out the crop shrimp to the side of the road. All of the rodent creatures notice it, and then make a run for the shrimp to eat it. The path is briefly open!

choices: Examine the edges of the stone
Examine the writing on the front
description: Nomiani decides to move quickly, while the rodent creatures are occupied with the crop shrimp. They head down to the lowest area of the pit, where the ground flattens out. Hot springs around the area spout up steam. In the center stands the everstone; a black metal square sunk into the earth. It looks like there's ancient writing on it, and some sort of handles at the four sides.

choices: Examine the edges of the stone
Stop to rest and clear their head
description:
They decide to look at the writing on the front first. There's words across the top of the stone…it's barely visible, almost worn away, but legible enough to deduce that it says the following:

AFOE STATION EXIT
SW ENTRANCE

TO OPEN: 4 PERSONS LIFT SIMULTANEOUSLY

For some reason, looking at this makes their brain hurt.

choices: Examine the edges of the stone
Keep trying to think through this
description:
Nomiani decides to try and rest.

Once they do, they again dream of the continued computer message. A little more is added, with the full sentence now saying "QUESTION RE: CLIMATE CHANGE ACTION

WHAT SHOULD WE DO TO AVOID THE WORST OUTCOMES?"

Suddenly, the dream is interrupted by the phrase COMPLETE BLUE PROTOCOL repeating over and over and over again until the scene is completely whited out. They wake up again, with their brain hurting even worse now.
